description.value:
Duration constant

Allies in a space you could reach with a single Step gain resistance to physical damage equal to one-quarter your level, and cannot be critically hit by an attack you could have redirected. You do not have to redirect it, and you do not have to have a reaction available — the option existing is what downgrades the hit.

cinderfall.incomplete: Grants adjacent allies resistance = 1/4 level to physical damage, and immunity to a critical hit from any attack the caster "could have redirected" (no actual reaction spent). No selector applies a resistance grant from the caster's own passive to a different creature (the default absence confirmed across this whole pass), and no companion effect item exists for this slug to carry it. Real precedent for ally-defense grants tied to a protector's stance/action exists (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/guardian/level-8/shield-from-arrows.json, level-2/covering-stance.json, both rules: []), but every example found ties the benefit to an actual stance/action state, never to a pure hypothetical ("you didn't have to have a reaction available") -- no matching precedent for that stronger claim.
